intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She folds the security report into precise thirds, then unfolds it to read it again.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “It may be the finest document I have ever signed.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Page two. A suspicious noise was investigated. It was a heron.”

options.labelText: “That’s excellent work. Frame the heron part.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Page two, framed. The heron will be insufferable.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She tucks the report inside her collar. It is not going back to the archive.

options.labelText: “Shame, though. A bit of action would’ve made a better story.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “I am employed to prevent better stories.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She files the report with the others. The heron goes unappreciated.
